input: و فی کلّ الزّبرات و المزامیر و الصّحائف لموجود و مذکور بمثل ما ذکرت لک و القیت علیک بل اعلی و اعظم عن کلّ ما ذکرت و فصّلت.
output: References similar to those mentioned, nay even more sublime and exalted, have been made in all the Books and Scriptures of old.
prediction: And in every verse, psalm, and Tablet, that which existeth and is mentioned is made known and presented to thee, even more exalted and sublime than that which thou hast recounted and detailed.

input: و انّی لو ارید ان اذکر کلّ ما نزّل من قبل لأقدر بما اعطانی الله من بدائع علمه و قدرته.
output: Should it be My wish to recount all that hath been revealed in the past, I would most certainly be able to do so by virtue of that which God hath bestowed upon Me of the wonders of His knowledge and power.
prediction: And verily, if I desired to make mention of all that hath been revealed, I could do so with what God hath bestowed upon me of the wondrous manifestations of His knowledge and power.

input: ولکن اکتفیت بما بیّنت لک لئلّا تکسل فی سفرک و لا تنقلب علی عقبیک و لئلّا یأخذک من حزن و لا کدورة و لا من نصب و لا من ذلّ و لا من لغوب.
output: I have, however, contented Myself with that which was mentioned, lest thou become wearied in thy journey or feel inclined to turn back, or lest thou be overtaken by sadness and sorrow and overcome with despondency, trouble and fatigue.
prediction: But suffice it that Thou hast been made aware thereof, that Thou mayest not slacken in Thy journey, nor turn back upon Thy steps, nor be overtaken by sorrow, nor despondency, nor weariness, nor humiliation, nor despair.

input: اذاً فأنصف ثمّ فکّر فی تلک العبارات المتعالیات.
output: Be fair in thy judgement and reflect upon these exalted utterances.
prediction: Then judge aright and ponder these exalted utterances.

input: ثمّ اسأل عن الّذین یدّعون العلم من دون بیّنة من عند الله و لا حجّة من لدنه و غفلوا عن تلک الأیّام الّتی اشرقت شمس العلم و الحکمة عن افق الألوهیّة و تعطی کلّ ذی حقّ حقّه و کلّ ذی قدر مقداره و مقامه ما یقولون فی هذه الاشارات.
output: Inquire, then, of those who lay claim to knowledge without a proof or testimony from God, and who remain heedless of these days wherein the Orb of knowledge and wisdom hath dawned above the horizon of Divinity, rendering unto each his due and assigning unto all their rank and measure, as to what they can say concerning these allusions.
prediction: Then we beseech Thee concerning those who claim knowledge without any proof from God, nor any argument from Him, and have forgotten those days when the sun of knowledge and wisdom shone forth from the horizon of divinity, granting to every one his due, bestowing upon each according to his capacity and station what they say about these signs.

input: الّتی ذهلت العقول عن ادراکها و حارت النّفوس المقدّسة عن عرفان ما ستر فیها من حکمة الله البالغة و علم الله المودعة.
output: Verily, their meaning hath bewildered the minds of men, and that which they conceal of the consummate wisdom and latent knowledge of God even the most sanctified souls have been powerless to uncover.
prediction: Which hath stupefied the intellects in their comprehension thereof, and perplexed the sanctified souls in their recognition of the mysteries enshrined therein of God's perfect wisdom and His deposited knowledge.

input: ان یقولون هذه الکلمات من عند الله و لم یکن لها من تأویل و تکون علی ظاهر القول فی ظاهر الظّاهر فکیف یعترضون علی هؤلآء الکفرة من اهل الکتاب.
output: Should they say: These words are indeed from God, and have no interpretation other than their outward meaning, then what objection can they raise against the unbelievers among the people of the Book.
prediction: And they say these words are from God and have no interpretation, and are to be taken on the surface of the saying, according to the surface of the saying; how then can they object to these infidels of the People of the Book?

input: لأنّهم لمّا شهدوا فی کتابهم ما ذکرناه لک و فسّروا لهم علمائهم علی ظاهر القول لذا ما اقرّوا بالله فی مظاهر التّوحید و مطالع التّفرید و هیاکل التّجرید و ما آمنوا بهم و ما اطاعوهم.
output: For when the latter saw the aforementioned passages in their Scriptures and heard the literal interpretations of their divines, they refused to recognize God in those who are the Manifestations of His unity, the Exponents of His singleness, and the Embodiments of His sanctity, and failed to believe in them and submit to their authority.
prediction: For when they saw in their Book what We had not mentioned to them, and their learned ones interpreted it according to the literal sense of the words, therefore they did not acknowledge God in the Manifestations of Unity, the Ascent to Solitude, and the Foundations of Abstractness, and they neither believed in them nor obeyed them.

input: لأنّهم ما شهدوا بأن تظلم الشّمس و تساقط الکواکب من السّمآء علی وجه الأرض و تنزلنّ الملائکة علی ظاهر الهیکل علی الأرض لذا اعترضوا علی النّبیّین و المرسلین.
output: The reason was that they did not see the sun darken, or the stars of heaven fall to the ground, or the angels visibly descend upon the earth, and hence they contended with the Prophets and Messengers of God.
prediction: Because they had not witnessed the obscuring of the sun and the falling of the constellations from the heavens upon the face of the earth, nor the descent of the angels upon the manifest sanctuary of the earth, therefore they opposed the Prophets and the Messengers.

input: بل لمّا وجدوهم مخالفاً لدینهم و شرائعهم وردوا علیهم ما استحیی ان اذکر لک من الکذب و الجنون و الکفر و الضّلال.
output: Nay, inasmuch as they found them at variance with their own faith and creed, they hurled against them such accusations of imposture, folly, waywardness, and misbelief as I am ashamed to recount.
prediction: But when they found them at variance with their religion and their laws, they returned unto them what would blush to relate, even of lying, madness, unbelief, and error.

input: فأرجع البصر فی القرآن لتجد کلّ ذلک و تکون فیه من العارفین.
output: Refer to the Qur'án, that thou mayest find mention of all this and be of them that understand its meaning.
prediction: Return thy gaze, O thou of understanding, into the Quran, that thou mayest find all of that, and become among the knowers thereof.

input: و من یومئذ الی حینئذ ینتظرون هذه الفئة ظهورات ما عرفوا من علمائهم و ایقنوا من فقهائهم.
output: Even to this day do these people await the appearance of that which they have learned from their doctors and imbibed from their divines.
prediction: And from that day henceforth until that time, they shall await the appearances of this sect, which they have come to recognize through the teachings of their learned ones and the judgments of their jurists.

input: و یقولون متی تظهر هذه العلامات انّا حینئذ لآمنون.
output: Thus do they say: When shall these signs be made manifest, that we may believe.
prediction: And they say: When shall these signs be made manifest? Verily, at that time we shall believe.

input: و لو کان الأمر کذلک کیف انتم تدحضون حجّتهم و تبطلون برهانهم و تحتجّون بهم فی امر دینهم و ما عرفوا من کتبهم و سمعوا من صنادیدهم.
output: But if this be the case, how could ye refute their arguments, invalidate their proofs, and challenge them concerning their faith and their understanding of their Books and the sayings of their leaders.
prediction: And if this were the case, how could ye confute their testimony, and invalidate their proof, and argue with them concerning the affair of their religion, and that which they know not of their books, and that which they have not heard from their traditions?

input: و ان یقولون هذه الأسفار الّتی تکون بین یدی هذه الفئة و یسمّونها بالانجیل و ینسبونها بعیسی بن مریم ما نزلت من عند الله و مظاهر نفسه یلزم تعطیل الفیض عن مبدإ الفیّاض.
output: And should they reply: The Books that are in the hands of this people, which they call the Gospel and attribute to Jesus, the Son of Mary, have not been revealed by God and proceed not from the Manifestations of His Self, then this would imply a cessation in the abounding grace of Him Who is the Source of all grace.
prediction: And if they say: These scriptures which shall be in the hands of this community, and they call them the Gospels, and attribute them to Jesus, the Son of Mary, what hath not descended from God and what manifestations of His Self are these, it behooves them to deny the cessation of the effulgence from the Source of effulgence.

input: و لم تکن الحجّة من عند الله بالغة علی عباده و لم تکن النّعمة کاملة.
output: If so, God's testimony to His servants would have remained incomplete and His favour proven imperfect.
prediction: And verily the Proof was not from God complete unto His servants, nor was the bounty perfect.

input: و لا العنایة مشرقة و لا الرّحمة واسعة.
output: His mercy would not have shone resplendent, nor would His grace have overshadowed all.
prediction: And neither is the care of Thy providence resplendent, nor is Thy mercy extensive.

input: لأنّه لمّا رفع عیسی الی السّمآء و رفع کتابه فبأیّ شیء یحتجّ الله بهم یوم القیامة و یعذّبهم کما هو المکتوب من ائمّة الدّین و المنصوص من علمآء الرّاشدین.
output: For if at the ascension of Jesus His Book had likewise ascended unto heaven, then how could God reprove and chastise the people on the Day of Resurrection, as hath been written by the Imáms of the Faith and affirmed by its illustrious divines.
prediction: O God, verily, when Jesus was raised up into heaven and His Book was lifted up, by what token shall God adjure them on the Day of Resurrection and torment them, as is written concerning the leaders of religions and as is established by the learned of the rightly-guided?

input: اذاً فکّر فی نفسک لمّا تشهد الأمر کذلک و نشهد کذلک من این تفرّ و الی من ترکض.
output: Ponder then in thine heart: Matters being such as thou dost witness, and as We also witness, where canst thou flee, and with whom shalt thou take refuge.
prediction: Therefore, reflect upon thyself when thou beholdest the Cause thus, and we behold it thus; from henceforth, turn away, and whither dost thou run?

input: و الی من تتوجّه.
output: Unto whom wilt thou turn thy gaze.
prediction: And unto Whom dost thou turn?

input: و بأیّ ارض تسکن و بأیّ فراش تجلس.
output: In what land shalt thou dwell and upon what seat shalt thou abide.
prediction: And in whatever land thou dwellest, and upon whatever couch thou sittest.

input: و بأیّ صراط تستقیم و بأیّ ساعة تنوم.
output: In what path shalt thou tread and at what hour wilt thou find repose.
prediction: And by what Path dost thou walk aright, and in what hour dost thou take thy rest?

input: و بأیّ امر تنتهی امرک.
output: What shall become of thee in the end.
prediction: And in what commandment doth Thy commandment terminate?

input: و بأیّ شیء تشدّ عروة دینک و حبل طاعتک.
output: Where shalt thou secure the cord of thy faith and fasten the tie of thine obedience.
prediction: And by what thing dost Thou strengthen the bond of Thy Faith and the cord of Thy obedience.

input: لا فوالّذی تجلّی بالوحدانیّة و تشهد لنفسه بالفردانیّة.
output: By Him Who revealeth Himself in His oneness and Whose own Self beareth witness to His unity.
prediction: There is none other save Him, verily He Whose effulgence is manifested in the oneness and Who beareth witness to His own singleness.

input: لو یحدث فی قلبک قبساً من نار محبّة الله ما تنوم و ما تسکن و ما تضحک و ما تستریح بل تفرّ الی قلل الجبال فی ساحة القرب و القدس و الجمال.
output: Should there be ignited in thy heart the burning brand of the love of God, thou wouldst seek neither rest nor composure, neither laughter nor repose, but wouldst hasten to scale the highest summits in the realms of divine nearness, sanctity, and beauty.
prediction: If within thine heart a spark of God’s love should be kindled, thou wilt neither sleep nor rest, neither smile nor find ease; but wilt rush unto the summits of mountains in the fields of proximity, holiness, and beauty.

input: و تنوح کنوح الفاقدین و تبکی کبکآء المشتاقین.
output: Thou wouldst lament as a soul bereaved and weep as a heart filled with longing.
prediction: And weep thou as doth he who is bereft, and mourn thou as doth he who is consumed with longing.

input: و لا ترجع الی بیتک و محلّک الّا بأن یکشف الله لک امره.
output: Nor wouldst thou repair to thy home and abode unless God would lay bare before thee His Cause.
prediction: And thou wilt not return to Thy house and Thine abode save when God doth reveal unto thee Thy purpose.

input: و انّک انت یا ایّها المتعارج الی جبروت الهدی و المتصاعد الی ملکوت التّقی.
output: O thou who hast soared to the realm of guidance and ascended to the kingdom of virtue.
prediction: And verily Thou art, O Thou Who dost ascend to the realm of glory of guidance and dost soar to the Kingdom of piety.

input: لو ترید ان تعرف هذه الاشارات القدسیّة و تشهد اسرار العلمیّة و تطّلع علی کلمة الجامعة
output: Shouldst thou desire to apprehend these celestial allusions, to witness the mysteries of divine knowledge, and to become acquainted with His all-encompassing Word,
prediction: Couldst thou but wish to know these holy allusions, and witness the mysteries of divine knowledge, and discover the Word of Unity, thou wouldst perceive the tokens of God's holiness and behold the secrets of spiritual insight.

input: لا بدّ لجنابک ان تسأل کلّ ذلک و کلّ ما یرد علیک فی امر مبدئک و معادک عن الّذین جعلهم الله منبع علمه و سمآء حکمته و سفینة سرّه.
output: then it behoveth thine eminence to inquire into these and other questions pertaining to thine origin and ultimate goal from those whom God hath made to be the Wellspring of His knowledge, the Heaven of His wisdom, and the Ark of His mysteries.
prediction: It is incumbent upon Thee, O Thou Who art the Source of all, to inquire concerning all of this and whatsoever is brought forth concerning Thy primal Purpose and Thy terminal Destiny, of those whom God hath made the fount of His knowledge and the heaven of His wisdom, and the ship of His secret.

input: لأنّ من دون هذه الأنوار المشرقة عن افق الهویّة ما یعرفون النّاس یمینهم عن شمائلهم و کیف یقدرنّ ان یتعارجنّ الی افق الحقائق او یصلنّ الی مخزن الدّقائق.
output: For were it not for those effulgent Lights that shine above the horizon of His Essence, the people would know not their left hand from their right, how much less could they scale the heights of the inner realities or probe the depths of their subtleties.
prediction: Verily, without these resplendent lights from the Horizon of Imagination, men would know not the people by their attributes, nor could they attain to the Horizon of Truths, or reach the Treasury of Subtleties.

input: اذاً نسأل الله بأن یدخلنا فی هذه البحور المتموّجة و یشرّفنا الی هذه الأرواح المرشّحة و ینزلنا فی هذه المعارج الالهیّة .
output: We beseech God therefore to immerse us in these surging seas, to grace us with the presence of these life-bearing breezes, and to cause us to abide in these divine and lofty precincts.
prediction: Therefore, we beseech God that He cause us to enter into these surging oceans, and honor us with these purified spirits, and descend us into these divine stations.

input: لننزع عن هیاکلنا کلّ ما اخذنا من عند انفسنا و نخلع عن اجسادنا کلّ الأثواب العاریة الّتی سرقنا عن امثالنا لیلبسنا الله من قمص عنایته و اثواب هدایته و یدخلنا فی مدینة العلم.
output: Perchance we may divest ourselves of all that we have taken from each other and strip ourselves of such borrowed garments as we have stolen from our fellow men, that He may attire us instead with the robe of His mercy and the raiment of His guidance, and admit us into the city of knowledge.
prediction: We will strip away from our edifices all that we have taken from ourselves, and will remove from our bodies every naked garment which we have stolen from our equals, that God may clothe us with the raiment of His compassion and the garments of His guidance, and admit us into the city of knowledge.

input: الّذی من دخل فیها لیعرف کلّ العلوم قبل ان یلتفت الی اسرارها و یعرف کلّ العلم و الحکمة من اسرار الرّبوبیّة المودعة فی کنائز الخلیقة من اوراقها الّتی تورّقت من اشجارها.
output: Whosoever entereth this city will comprehend every science before probing into its mysteries and will acquire from the leaves of its trees a knowledge and wisdom encompassing such mysteries of divine lordship as are enshrined within the treasuries of creation.
prediction: He who entereth therein shall know all the sciences ere he turneth to its mysteries, and shall comprehend all knowledge and wisdom enshrined in the secrets of Thy Lordship deposited in the treasuries of creation, from the leaves thereof that have withered from the boughs thereof.

input: فسبحان الله موجدها و مبدعها عمّا خلق فیها و قدّر لها.
output: Glorified be God, its Creator and Fashioner, above all that He hath brought forth and ordained therein.
prediction: Verily, glorified be God, the Creator and Fashioner of all that He hath brought into being and ordained for them.

input: و انّی فوالله المهیمن المقتدر القیّوم.
output: By God, the Sovereign Protector, the Self-Subsisting, the Almighty.
prediction: And verily I swear by God, the Omnipotent, the Omnipresent, the Self-Subsisting.

input: لو ارینّک ابواب هذه المدینة الّتی خلقت عن یمین القدرة و القوّة لتری ما لا رأی احد من قبلک و تشهد ما لا شهدت نفس دونک.
output: Were I to unveil to thine eyes the gates of this city, which have been fashioned by the right hand of might and power, thou wouldst behold that which none before thee hath ever beheld, and wouldst witness that which no other soul hath ever witnessed.
prediction: Were We to show thee the portals of this city which Thou didst create from the right hand of power and might, thou wouldst behold that which none hath seen before thee, and witness that which no soul hath perceived save through Thee.

input: و تعرف غوامض الدّلالات و معضلات الاشارات و تبرهن لک اسرار البدئیّة فی نقطة الختمیّة.
output: Thou wouldst apprehend the most obscure signs and the most abstruse allusions, and wouldst clearly behold the mysteries of the beginning in the point of the end.
prediction:
